title: Home Purchase Agreement Amendment Fees and Limits
content:
Buyer statements for the Home Purchase Agreement carry a fee for each buyer-requested amendment. The amounts and limits are set per collection.

| Collection | Plan or elevation change fee (USD) | Last stage for a plan change | Homesite transfer fee (USD) | Homesite transfers allowed | Assignment to another person allowed | Other buyer-requested amendment fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pathway Collection | 750.00 | Not started | 500.00 | 1 | No | 150.00 |
| Meadow Collection | 1000.00 | Not started | 750.00 | 1 | No | 150.00 |
| Heritage Collection | 1500.00 | Not started | 1000.00 | 1 | No | 250.00 |
| Crestview Collection | 2000.00 | Not started | 1500.00 | 1 | No | 250.00 |
| Summit Collection | 2500.00 | Not started | 2000.00 | 1 | No | 350.00 |
| Reserve Collection | 3500.00 | Not started | 3000.00 | 2 | No | 500.00 |

## Statement reference

- **Plan or elevation change fee**: the fee for changing the plan or elevation after signing.
- **Last stage for a plan change**: the last construction stage at which a plan or elevation change is accepted. It is the stage "not started" in every collection, meaning before the foundation is started.
- **Homesite transfer fee**: the fee for moving the agreement to another homesite in the same community.
- **Homesite transfers allowed**: the most homesite transfers per agreement; 2 in the Reserve Collection and 1 in every other collection.
- **Assignment allowed**: whether the buyer may assign the agreement to another person. No collection allows it.
- **Other buyer-requested amendment fee**: the fee for a buyer-requested amendment other than a plan change or homesite transfer, such as adding or removing a co-buyer or changing the vesting.

**Example (hypothetical).** A hypothetical Summit Collection buyer who adds a co-buyer is charged 350.00 as the other-amendment fee; a plan change on that agreement, accepted while construction has not started, carries 2500.00.
